scope: Retrospective exposed forearm gesture subjects; digitally mixed measured channels, classwise support is not a globally chronological prefix or analog wearable measurement
physical_cost: eight array contacts plus common reference; eight AFE channels

selection_rules.single_first: half day-one CV plus half first-support transfer
selection_rules.mean_two: half day-one CV plus half mean of two separate support transfer scores
selection_rules.worst_two: half day-one CV plus half minimum of two separate support transfer scores
selection_rules.support_mean_only: mean of two support transfer scores

nested_budget_replay.meaning: Ten nested permutations of each same 5000-program pool; all scores precomputed; no independent subjects or runtime speedup claim
